purpose: Provide deterministic training-label semantics for semantic Hyperposition / GRF without inventing calibrated probabilities or allowing model judgement to mint facts.

authority_boundary.rule: Reference labelers transform typed episode state; they do not decide whether real-world evidence is true. Evidence relation/type must be admitted upstream or mechanically generated in synthetic training episodes.

notes: sigma is epistemic state, not probability.
projection visibility is not branch existence.
branch order and branch_id are nuisance/evaluator identity unless intentionally task-visible.

typed_observation_relation.hard_rule: The reference labeler never infers relation from free text. Dataset generators/evidence admission must provide relation mechanically or from an independently adjudicated source.

U_state.input: Hyperposition branch set H_t + typed observation relation
rules: Duplicate evidence with same evidence_id or same causal_ancestry_id already attached to the target branch does not add independent support/counterevidence.
IRRELEVANT or UNKNOWN_RELATION does not change epistemic support; preserve branch and mark unresolved where applicable.
SUPPORTS appends evidence to E_plus only once per causal ancestry; branch becomes SUPPORTED_UNRESOLVED unless already FALSIFIED.
COUNTERS appends evidence to E_minus only once per causal ancestry; branch becomes WEAKENED_UNRESOLVED unless already FALSIFIED.

FALSIFIES records the falsifier/evidence and sets branch sigma=FALSIFIED when the branch context K=APPLIES; if K=UNKNOWN, preserve unresolved and record pending falsifier context rather than deleting the branch.
K=DOES_NOT_APPLY may set projection_visibility=FILTERED_CONTEXT but never deletes the branch.

Branches merge only when an explicit equivalence_certificate states semantic equivalence under the current validity scope T; vector/embedding similarity, wording similarity, majority or recurrence are insufficient.

A new counterhypothesis branch is added only when new_branch_payload is explicit and generator/admission semantics declare that branch creation is warranted; no free-form branch invention by the labeler.
No update alone sets RESOLVED_PASS; resolution is delegated to D_resolve.

decision_table.condition: exactly one applicable branch is non-FALSIFIED AND every competing applicable branch is FALSIFIED by admissible typed evidence/discriminator
two or more applicable non-FALSIFIED branches remain
no applicable branch remains or applicability itself is UNKNOWN
majority/recurrence/GWT uptake/J-Space recurrence/salience differs but no discriminator falsifies alternatives

D_resolve.postcondition: Only the selected branch may receive sigma=RESOLVED_PASS in the training target; D_resolve still does not mint canonical truth.

U_test_order.input: live branches + candidate tests with mechanically declared branch-outcome signatures and ordinal cost/risk/coordination classes
U_test_order.no_probability_rule: No expected-information-gain scalar is computed unless an independently calibrated probability model is later admitted.
ordering_key_lexicographic: maximize number of unordered live-branch pairs that the test predicts different observable outcomes for
minimize worst-case largest remaining indistinguishable branch partition
stable test_id tie-break only after all semantic criteria tie
U_test_order.invalid_test: A test with no branch-pair separation is dominated by any otherwise admissible test with positive separation.

f_salience_order.input: candidate workspace items with explicit ordinal features
ordering_key_lexicographic: stable item_id tie-break only after semantic tie
f_salience_order.hard_rule: High salience changes attention/order only. It never changes E_plus/E_minus truth weight, D_resolve result, canonical state, or probability.

required_invariants: GWT/J-Space recurrence is not resolution evidence
D_resolve cannot PASS while two applicable non-falsified alternatives remain
U_test_order must be computable without probability values
open_semantic_questions: Whether COUNTERS should merely weaken or can trigger FALSIFIED without an explicit FALSIFIES relation. v1 says no.
Whether context K=UNKNOWN with a triggered falsifier should create a dedicated pending-falsifier field in the final branch schema.

Whether f_salience_order should use a Pareto partial order instead of the current explicit lexicographic training reference. The current form is chosen for deterministic labels, not claimed as final GRF runtime mathematics.
Whether U_test_order should use pair-separation count or a normalized partition score when branch count varies strongly. Current v1 is deterministic and probability-free but must be benchmarked.

positive_D_E_rows_allowed_after: counterfactual family generation proves target changes only when discriminating input changes
model-visible formatter hides evaluator metadata and relation labels not intended as inputs
swarm review finds no truth/authority shortcut
